checks.description: Brain planner has a canonical quest Active Goal factory (analogous to firemakingGoal)
checks.evidence: Brain planner has factories for firemaking, woodcutting, fishing, cooking, prayer, combat, exploration, follow — but no quest-* factory. Without one, the orchestrator cannot seed a deterministic Cook's Assistant goal; the Brain has to invent one from prose, and there is no predicate (isQuestGoal) to route it to a Body routine.
